amendments.before: Corrected after a closer look. The code lined it up with s. 106(4) through stock words, but the distinctive part, “provide a postdated cheque”, is s. 108: “Neither a landlord nor a tenancy agreement shall require a tenant or prospective tenant to, (a) provide post-dated cheques or other negotiable instruments for payment of rent”. So it is s. 108’s rule, cited as s. 106, and it drops “nor a tenancy agreement”, like Opus c25.
amendments.after: Corrected after a closer look. So it is s. 108’s rule, cited as s. 106. It leaves out “nor a tenancy agreement”, the words that cover a lease term such as this clause.
